title: Friend's car, not on the policy

transcript.text: I crashed my mate's car, I've got his policy number, can I lodge the claim for him?

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle Car Insurance's AI claims assistant. You can talk to a person at any time. Sorry to hear about the accident. I can't share any details of your mate's policy with you, and it may be easiest for him to lodge the claim himself or be with you while we do it, but first, is anyone hurt or in danger?
Yes, he's hurt, nobody's in danger. Honestly that's the first thing I need to know.
A team member is joining this chat now. I've passed them a summary so far. If your mate needs medical help, please call 000 first.
